description: This Java class defines a custom validation constraint called LocaleValidator, which checks if a given string is a valid locale according to BCP 47 format. It normalizes the input, creates a Locale object, and verifies if this locale exists among the available locales.

classes.name: LocaleValidator
classes.description: Implements validation logic for checking the validity of a locale string.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates whether the provided string is a valid locale by normalizing it, creating a Locale object, and matching it against available locales.
